notes.title: V0.2 Playtest - The Fate System Arrives!
notes.content:
[h3]⚔️ [b]What Is the Fate System?[/b][/h3][p align="start"]An [b]auxiliary roguelike layer[/b] that tackles two core goals:
🎯 [b]Deepen decision-making[/b] – more surprises, less repetition
🎯 [b]Expand strategic skill expression[/b] – reward clever plays[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔮 [b]How It Works[/b][/h3][p]🃏 [b]Fate Cards[/b][/p][list][*][p]New skills activated before combat by [b]spending specific dice[/b] (e.g., one “6”)[/p][/*][*][p][i]Note: Only a portion of cards are available in this test[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🎲 [b]Acquiring Fate Cards[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/619f80f56076048962562ed2cb56f38b8706ec0e.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Start of each run: [b]Choose 1 of 3 random Fate Cards[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Forge [b]Master[/b] or [b]Divine[/b] relics: Choose 1 of 3[/p][/*][*][p]Purchase non-Apprentice relics: [b]Chance to trigger 3-choice draft[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Roll straights or triples during dice phase: Choose 1 of 3[/p][/*][*][p][b]Max 5 Fate Cards equipped[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🎯 [b]Dice & Activation[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/f04ff855c00ff7247d1755221987076cf50ece40.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/d51943db8f33940e46a3772bcd62f31b075b63d9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/15fb5ee91318d2bcaf4035a9e4c115b9cfdedff8.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Dice are [b]resources to activate Fate Cards[/b] (e.g., spend a “4” pip)[/p][/*][*][p]Start with [b]two 6-sided dice[/b]; upgrade to [b]max 5 via shop[/b][/p][/*][*][p]In the [b]Fate Phase[/b] (pre-combat), roll dice, then [b]drag pips onto cards[/b] to activate them[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]⚔️ [b]Fate in Combat[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/686bae4fddd50ea52a026122c4ea147693d070dc.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Activated cards function like [b]bonus relics for one battle only[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Reset each round – adapt to new dice rolls![/p][/*][*][p]In close matches, [b]Fate strategy becomes the tiebreaker[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][/h3][p]We’re excited to bring you a fresh experience and look forward to your valuable feedback![/p][p][/p][p][b]Wishlist Fighting Rogue:[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3378130/_Fighting_Rogue/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: 【Dev Log】Fate Dice System - New Tactical Depth Incoming!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Why We Chose Fate Dice[/b][/h3][p]After playtesting multiple roguelike prototypes, your feedback crowned [b]Fate Dice[/b] as the winner! This system solves two core issues:
1️⃣ [b]Replayability Boost[/b]: Fresh decisions every run.
2️⃣ [b]Skill Expression[/b]: Your choices directly impact combat success.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Core Mechanics Breakdown[/b][/h3][p][b]Core Fate Cards[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/906f6414d45cd85474529b2e02c080240467528e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/fa94edcb25e23d9db1a9758f49901986fcca3da3.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Role[/b]: Faction-defining ultimates (e.g., Cold Plum's assassination techniques)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Activation[/b]: Consume specific [b]dice pips[/b] (e.g., one 6-pip die)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Impact[/b]: Grants battle-changing skills for [b]one fight only[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Customization[/b]: Choose 1 of 3 cards per faction pre-run[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Support Fate Cards[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/3ef46c40a7fb3eaf9c4d7e71a06735dbeab6e31f.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Role[/b]: Fuel Core Fate activation[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mechanic[/b]: Low pip cost (e.g., 1-3 pips) → [b]Refunds rarer pips[/b] (e.g., spend 2, get 6)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Synergy[/b]: Chain reactions enable powerful Core activations[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Dice Economy[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/1fc8c59e7b254e9f37162a3fe06068d0a6f9c0b0.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Start with [b]two 6-pip dice[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Unlock more via shop upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]Allocate dice strategically during the [b]Fate Phase[/b] (pre-combat minigame)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Fate Phase: Your Tactical Playground[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/db49cb5ec14c7be5e1f1025e6b897a28db47c9d8.png"][/img][/p][olist][*][p][b]Roll[/b] your dice pool (e.g., rolls: 1,2,3,4,5)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Drag & allocate[/b] pips to activate Fate Cards[/p][/*][*][p][b]Chain refunds[/b]: Activate Support Cards first to fuel Core Cards!
[i]Example: Spend "2" on "Qi Flow" (Support) → get "6" → use "6" on "Lethal Strike" (Core)[/i][/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][h3][b]Progression & Collection[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/750cbba4da5be441d1a2b063ef5bbdbe6d7ac5e8.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]100+ Support Cards[/b] to discover[/p][/*][*][p][b]Forge powerful relics[/b] to earn Fate Cards:[/p][list][*][p]Grandmaster relics → [b]3-choice Fate Card packs[/b] (Core/Support)[/p][/*][*][p]Divine relics → [b]Guaranteed elite Fate Cards[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]What This Means for Combat[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45617908/24f7dab64fc94aa2106423990e46983720858856.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Activated Fate Cards function like [b]combat relics[/b] with one-battle effects[/p][/*][*][p]Every fight demands [b]new dice strategies[/b]—no autopiloting![/p][/*][*][p]Future PvP balance will hinge on Fate Dice mastery[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Wishlist Fighting Rogue:[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3378130/_Fighting_Rogue/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

As we'll be revamping core gameplay systems, all ranked data will be reset.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Your Voice, Our Compass[/b][/h3][p]Thanks a ton for your awesome suggestions! With your guidance, we’ll deliver an experience worthy of the Jianghu![/p][p][/p][p][b]Wishlist Fighting Rogue:[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3378130/_Fighting_Rogue/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: V0.1 Playtest: Community Feedback & Dev Response
notes.content: [h3][b]Hey Jianghu Heroes![/b][/h3][p]Thanks for playing [i]Rogue Wulin[/i] and sharing your feedback! We’ve compiled your top questions—let’s dive in:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Q: "Can we combo three manuals into one?"[/b][/h3][p]A: [i]Great idea![/i] We’re exploring this as a potential faction mechanic. Stay tuned![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Q: "Will you add PvE modes like [i]Slay the Spire[/i]? (PvE early, PvP late)"[/b][/h3][p]A: PvE is on our radar, but dev resources are tight. We’re prototyping options![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Q: "Any plans for multiplayer?"[/b][/h3][p]A: Likely post-PvE. Debating formats (auto-chess? 3v3?). For now, we’re polishing core gameplay.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Q: "Faction weapons need more visual distinction."[/b][/h3][p]A: Agreed! Each faction already has [b]12 unique manuals[/b]. We’ll add [b]faction-exclusive relics[/b] soon![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Q: "Male characters? That guy in the screenshot?"[/b][/h3][p]A: YES! The fist-fighting dude in our Steam caps? He’s from a new faction—coming soon! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656215/9949dd34f859b6f558d5f1c5791c14a40465c1a5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Q: "Ultimate move animations are too rare!"[/b][/h3][p]A: Update incoming! We’ll:[/p][list][*][p]Show ults [b]every round[/b] (first use)[/p][/*][*][p]Add an [b]animation toggle[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656215/4e42f08418713123b267df47aa1096bdb45b8035.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Q: "Dodge is OP! Buff DoT builds!"[/b][/h3][p]A: Balancing is ongoing. We’re crunching data to tune DoT/sustain![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Q: "Ults don’t scale with Inner Power?"[/b][/h3][p]A: Clarification:[/p][list][*][p][b]Outer Power[/b] ≈ [b]Physical DMG[/b] (e.g., Bai Xinyan’s ult)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Inner Power[/b] ≈ [b]Magical DMG[/b] (e.g., Su Lianxiang’s ult)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Q: "Progression feels grindy! 1% per 30-min run?!"[/b][/h3][p]A: Oops—[i]not our intent![/i] We’re [b]slashing grind[/b] and smoothing unlocks ASAP.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Q: "Cheating in async PvP?"[/b][/h3][p]A: Anti-cheat will launches with next playtest version. Fair matches guaranteed![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Q: "When does testing end?"[/b][/h3][p]A: TBD—we’ll announce dates once optimization goals are met. More tests coming![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Q: "Full release date?"[/b][/h3][p]A: We’re a small team polishing new modes/mechanics. No date yet, but we’re all-in![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Bugs & Optimizations[/b][/h3][p]We’re squashing reported issues—thanks for your patience![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Wishlist Fighting Rogue:[/b][/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3378130/_Fighting_Rogue/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes: V0.1.4
notes.content: [h3][b]Changes:[/b][/h3][olist][*][p][b]Ranked Points Optimization[/b]: Climbing ranks is now smoother in higher tiers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Early Exit Penalty Adjustment[/b]: Improved handling of ranked points when players quit mid-match.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Low-Tier Matchmaking[/b]: Enhanced gameplay experience for entry-level ranks.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h3][b]Fixes:[/b][/h3][olist][*][p][b]Shop Relic Preview[/b]: Fixed display bugs during pre-purchase.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Progress Loss Prevention[/b]: Resolved Steam save corruption upon abnormal game closure.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fame System[/b]: Fame progress now persists between matches (no longer reset).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Story Unlocks[/b]: Character and faction stories can now be properly unlocked.[/p][/*][/olist]
